items.content_html: Cloud-based real-time ECG monitoring system using IoT and AI. ECG signals are preprocessed and R-peaks detected with the Pan–Tompkins algorithm, then classified by a lightweight 1D-CNN for arrhythmia detection. A web dashboard provides live waveform visualization, heart-rate trends, and abnormal-rhythm alerts for remote healthcare monitoring.
